WITH patient_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) as patient_avg_aCL_IgM
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  WHERE e.`aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(patient_avg_aCL_IgM) as overall_mean_val
  FROM patient_avg
),
with_deviation AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.ID,
    pa.SEX,
    pa.patient_avg_aCL_IgM,
    pa.patient_avg_aCL_IgM - om.overall_mean_val as deviation
  FROM patient_avg pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
),
sex_avg_deviation AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(deviation) as sex_avg_dev
  FROM with_deviation
  GROUP BY SEX
),
with_sex_excess AS (
  SELECT 
    wd.ID,
    wd.SEX,
    wd.patient_avg_aCL_IgM,
    wd.deviation,
    wd.deviation - sad.sex_avg_dev as excess_above_sex_avg
  FROM with_deviation wd
  INNER JOIN sex_avg_deviation sad ON wd.SEX = sad.SEX
)
SELECT 
  ID,
  SEX,
  patient_avg_aCL_IgM,
  deviation,
  excess_above_sex_avg
FROM with_sex_excess
WHERE excess_above_sex_avg > 0
ORDER BY excess_above_sex_avg DESC, CASE WHEN SEX = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC
LIMIT 10
